metadata.name: directory-drilldown
metadata.description: From a seeded assistant message, click a directory link to open the file-preview viewer as a directory listing, verify hidden entries are filtered by default, walk into a nested directory, open a file inside it, then walk Back twice to the original listing.

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const tabs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="tab-"]')).filter((el) => { const id = el.getAttribute('data-testid') || ''; return id !== 'tab-bar' && id !== 'tab-bar-new' && !id.startsWith('tab-group-') && !id.startsWith('tab-rename-input-'); }); let opened = false; let hiddenFiltered = false; for (const tab of tabs) { tab.click(); await sleep(400); const toggle = document.querySelector('[data-testid="workspace-toggle-view"]'); if (toggle instanceof HTMLElement) { toggle.click(); await sleep(400); } const link = document.querySelector('a[href$="preview-dir"]'); if (link instanceof HTMLElement) { link.click(); await sleep(1200); const panel = document.querySelector('[data-testid="messages-file-viewer-panel"]'); const listing = document.querySelector('[data-testid="file-preview-directory"]'); if (panel && listing) { opened = true; const names = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="directory-entry"]')).map((el) => (el.textContent || '').trim()); hiddenFiltered = names.some((n) => n.indexOf('nested') === 0) && names.some((n) => n.indexOf('top.md') === 0) && !names.some((n) => n.indexOf('.hidden-env') === 0); break; } } } document.body.setAttribute('data-dirpreview-opened', opened ? 'true' : 'false'); document.body.setAttribute('data-dirpreview-hidden-filtered', hiddenFiltered ? 'true' : 'false'); })()

assert.failure_message: Expected the directory link to open the file-preview viewer with the directory renderer (this is the regression guard for 'Directories cannot be previewed')
Expected the default listing to show nested/ and top.md but not .hidden-env

metadata.label: Verify dot-prefixed entries are hidden by default

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); let descended = false; const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="directory-entry"]')); const nested = rows.find((el) => (el.textContent || '').trim().indexOf('nested') === 0); if (nested instanceof HTMLElement) { nested.click(); await sleep(1200); const rows2 = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="directory-entry"]')).map((el) => (el.textContent || '').trim()); const back = document.querySelector('[data-testid="file-preview-back"]'); descended = !!back && rows2.some((n) => n.indexOf('inner.md') === 0); } document.body.setAttribute('data-dirpreview-descended', descended ? 'true' : 'false'); })()

assert.failure_message: Expected clicking a directory row to list the nested directory and reveal the Back control

metadata.label: Verify the nested listing and the Back control

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); let openedFile = false; const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="directory-entry"]')); const inner = rows.find((el) => (el.textContent || '').trim().indexOf('inner.md') === 0); if (inner instanceof HTMLElement) { inner.click(); await sleep(1200); openedFile = !!document.querySelector('[data-testid="file-preview-markdown"]'); } document.body.setAttribute('data-dirpreview-opened-file', openedFile ? 'true' : 'false'); })()

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); let returned = false; for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) { const back = document.querySelector('[data-testid="file-preview-back"]'); if (!(back instanceof HTMLElement)) break; back.click(); await sleep(900); } const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="directory-entry"]')).map((el) => (el.textContent || '').trim()); returned = !!document.querySelector('[data-testid="file-preview-directory"]') && rows.some((n) => n.indexOf('top.md') === 0) && !document.querySelector('[data-testid="file-preview-back"]'); document.body.setAttribute('data-dirpreview-returned', returned ? 'true' : 'false'); })()
